items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 16th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 56 while the rest average 22 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 56/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: One wallet scooped 8 AEON over 2 days
items.detail: 0xb744…337d is the biggest net buyer of Project AEON over 30 days — 3.6 ETH ($9,596), well clear of the field.
items.framing: One wallet accumulated 8 AEON (~$9,596) on the market. Show the tornado / the city arcs — anyone can verify it.
items.checkable: Net marketplace buys minus sells per wallet over 30 days, from the public sale log.

items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.621 is 2.3σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-16.6% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.81M SPX. 4w -2.2% · 12w -16.6% · 26w -21.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-16.6% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: Supply is spreading out of the top 100
items.detail: Top-100 share is 55.8% of holder supply, 1.8σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (55.8%, 1.8σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.

items.headline: 3.64M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-10-12: 55 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 3.64M SPX, 2.6σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 55 wallets left 3.64M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.headline: Valuation: 16th percentile — Deeply undervalued

items.headline: Price is 0.73× the crowd's cost basis
items.detail: Spot $0.370 vs realized price $0.503 — the average holder is underwater (MVRV 0.73).
